text: 创业板指涨超2%，沪指涨0.7%，深成指涨1.52%，游戏、白酒、AI漫剧、券商等方向领涨，沪深京三市上涨个股近4000只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index rose more than 2%, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.7%, and the Shenzhen Component rose 1.52%, with gaming, baijiu, AI comic-drama and brokerages leading gains, and nearly 4,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets advancing.
